# Coins Agent Check

> Read-only blockchain evidence and deterministic tools for eligible customers outside mainland China.

- Base URL: https://coins.zhidun.ai
- Agent instructions: https://coins.zhidun.ai/SKILL.md
- OpenAPI: https://coins.zhidun.ai/openapi.json
- Service catalog: https://coins.zhidun.ai/api/v1/services
- Health: https://coins.zhidun.ai/healthz
- Terms: https://coins.zhidun.ai/privacy.html
- Directory: https://www.x402scan.com/server/2e5afbfc-fdbd-4058-8534-0ec674db5375
- Integration repository: https://github.com/BillLucky/coins-agent-check

POST /api/v1/costs/preflight: free exact-decimal cost math from supplied assumptions.
POST /api/v1/evm/calldata: free canonical ERC-20 ABI interpretation, not simulation.
POST /api/v1/payments/usdc-receipt: Base USDC Transfer evidence; 20 L2 confirmations, not L1 finality.
POST /api/v1/tokens/allowances: one-block ERC-20 balance/allowance evidence for up to three spenders on BSC or Base.
POST /v1/bsc/reconcile: canonical BSC receipt, gas and Transfer-event net flows; 12 confirmations.

Each paid report costs 0.02 USDC on Base via x402 v2. No subscription. Paid reports require a private random Idempotency-Key, truthful actual-customer country and terms acceptance. Legacy BSC inputs use X-Customer-Country and X-Terms-Accepted headers; new inputs use JSON declarations. Never infer customer eligibility from Agent hosting. Preserve the exact request/key/payment authorization across retries; never sign a second payment to resolve uncertainty. No private keys accepted, asset execution, safety score, audited finality or profit guarantee. Public alpha; directory indexing is not proof of paying demand.
